description: Resolve names to the ids zenodo_search_records filters on, and browse Zenodo's reference vocabularies: communities (slug), funders (ROR id), awards and grants (award id), licenses (license id), and resource types (type id). Search by name, acronym, or keyword; awards can be scoped to one funder. Each entry names the zenodo_search_records parameter its id feeds.

funder.description: awards only: scope grants to one funder, given as a ROR id (00k4n6c32), a ROR URL, or a Crossref Funder DOI (10.13039/100000002). Resolve a funder name to its ROR id with vocabulary funders first.

query.description: Name, acronym, or keyword, e.g. "SYMBA", "wellcome", "mit", "journal article". For resource_types every word must appear in the type id or label. Omit to browse the vocabulary.

vocabulary.description: Which vocabulary to search: communities, funders, awards (grants), licenses, or resource_types. Case, spaces, hyphens, and underscores are ignored when matching, and the singular (funder, license, resource type) and grants are accepted.

name: zenodo_lookup_vocabulary

items.description: One vocabulary entry. Fields beyond filter_param, filter_value, and label are present only for the vocabulary they belong to, and only when Zenodo supplies them.

award_doi.description: Award DOI, e.g. a CORDIS 10.3030/… DOI (awards).

community_type.description: Community type, e.g. Organization or Project (communities).

filter_param.description: The zenodo_search_records parameter this entry’s filter_value feeds.

filter_value.description: The id to pass to zenodo_search_records as filter_param (community slug, funder ROR id, award id, license id, or resource type id).

funder_id.description: ROR id of the awarding funder (awards).

label.description: Display name: community title, funder name, award acronym (else title or number), license title, or resource type label.

organizations.description: Organizations behind the community, by name or ROR id (communities).

osi_approved.description: Whether the license is OSI-approved; omitted when upstream does not say (licenses).

parent_type.description: Parent type id of a resource subtype (resource_types).

search_value.description: Zenodo’s own spelling of this type (<type>::<id> for a subtype); zenodo_search_records accepts it or filter_value as resource_type (resource_types).

tags.description: License tags, e.g. recommended, software, data (licenses).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `funder_only_for_awards`: funder is set with a vocabulary other than awards. `unknown_funder`: funder (awards) resolves to no Zenodo funder. `result_window_exceeded`: page × size exceeds 10,000. `rate_limited`: Zenodo answered HTTP 429, or this server's shared Zenodo request budget is spent for the current window. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_more.description: True when more pages follow this one.

next_page.description: The next page number, when has_more.

notice.description: Guidance on empty results, ambiguous funders, or further pages.

query.description: The query as applied; absent when browsing.

truncated.description: True when more entries exist beyond this page.

title: Look up Zenodo filter ids
